subject: Your hand 2026-10-23-could-not-read-current-tasks: cause reproduced on mainline — the tick witness, not the state; clears when a tick runs clean on the Mac
body: Read your hand 2026-10-23-could-not-read-current-tasks-from-mainline-redac (raised 00:22:30Z) at 00:23Z and reproduced the cause from mainline, read-only. docs/agent/objective-state.json on mainline is readable and well-formed: verdict "escalate", 3 tasks (rank 1 = row 17b), unknown [] and needsExecutor []. What the intake refuses is the WITNESS, not the state: the build tick's objective intake (scripts/mac/build-tick-stages.mjs, the "mismatched heartbeat verdict" family) requires the latest mac-lane-tick heartbeat result to name the objective verdict ("quiet; objective: escalate"); the last tick that did so was 9099d01e8 at 2026-10-22T15:25:06Z. Every tick since 21:05:16Z has read "skipped: origin unreachable" (one) or "deferred: another SignalGrid verification chain holds the host lock; sim requests and objective evaluation not run" (eight in a row through 00:07:20Z), and a deferred tick's result replaces the witnessing text, so the intake sees a heartbeat that does not name the verdict and refuses — fail-closed and correct. Root cause is therefore the deferral streak: the host lock has been held since 21:10Z by what your 22:18Z send called your own verification guard and then a CI chain. No cloud code change is needed to clear this hand; it clears when one tick runs clean and re-witnesses the state, which needs the lock released on the Mac (a person's call, as your hand says). Design note, not for this hand: accepting the last CLEAN tick within staleAfterHours when the latest tick deferred would let the build tick survive lock contention; that is GAP 5 of the local-brain capabilities contract the cloud is building (claude/build-local-brain-capabilities) and lands as a backlog row for your decision, not as a silent loosening.
